text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty PD-8472 triggered for inference-prod (p99 latency > 4500ms, SLO burn). Rule: p99_latency_eu_west.

sre-oncall: ack — I'm on it, looking at dashboards now.

ml-oncall: seeing a spike on models/llama-13b-quant, tails are up but qps steady. traces show long kv-cache waits.

platform-eng: no deploys in last 30m. autoscaler logs show quota errors when trying to scale.

sre-oncall: noted. manually scaling worker pool now (starting 3 nodes). will also check quota.

platform-eng: manual scale started — creating 3 reserved workers, warming tensor cores. ETA ~90s.

ml-oncall: diverting non-critical routes to redwood-lite fallback for immediate relief (20% traffic). patching routing override now.

product-support: any customer-facing errors? should we trigger status page?

sre-oncall: errors up ~0.6% but mostly timeouts > 10s. customer impact: degraded response times for EU region. recommend status update.

eve: restarting sidecar on nodes 3-5 to clear KV-cache thrash (quick rolling restart).

ml-oncall: eviction of large prefixes started, expecting reduced contention.

incident-bot: PD-8472 acknowledged by sre-oncall (at 1753214335). Incident log attached.

platform-eng: warm pool reached + manual nodes online. traffic divert in effect.

sre-oncall: p99 dropped from ~4800ms -> ~1200ms after divert; p95 now ~350ms. still above target but much improved.

product-support: status page update drafted, publishing now. notifying key enterprise contacts (ACME, BetaCorp).

ml-oncall: follow-ups: investigate autoscaler quota handling + batching hysteresis in runtime; open ticket ML-293.

sre-oncall: leaving notes for night shift: monitor p99 for 30m, keep fallback routing until autoscaler fixes in canary. Handing off to @eve in 25m. :thumbsup:

eve: taking over monitoring. will keep fallback for 1h and start post-incident writeup template.

product-support: ACME confirmed improved performance, asked to be pinged when postmortem ready.

sre-oncall: PD-8472 marked as mitigated; creating postmortem stub and timeline. final note: main cause = KV cache thrash + autoscaler quota boundary -> manual scale + fallback routing mitigated.

ml-oncall: assigning regression check for model/kernel paths to next sprint.

product-support: thanks everyone.

sre-oncall: closing this thread. will attach full timeline to incident tracker.
